_comment: rp DEFAULT_EXPRESSIONS (src/lib/vn/expressions.ts) -> danbooru-style expression tags. make-sprites.mjs substitutes one value per sprite into a character spec's {{expression}} slot. lowercase, spaces not underscores.

expressions.happy: smile, happy, soft blush, closed mouth
expressions.smirk: smirk, smug, half-closed eyes, one eyebrow raised, closed mouth
expressions.laughing: laughing, open mouth, wide grin, eyes closed, tilting head back, joyful, upper teeth visible
expressions.sad: sad, frown, downcast eyes, drooping eyebrows
expressions.crying: crying, tears, crying with eyes open, streaming tears, sad frown
expressions.angry: angry, scowl, furrowed brow, v-shaped eyebrows, gritted teeth
expressions.annoyed: annoyed, pout, half-closed eyes, unamused, slight frown
expressions.surprised: surprised, wide eyes, raised eyebrows, open mouth, shocked
expressions.scared: scared, fear, wide eyes, trembling, nervous, pale
expressions.blush: heavy blush, shy, embarrassed, averting eyes, closed mouth
expressions.love: in love, heart-shaped pupils, blush, tender smile
expressions.flirty: seductive smile, flirty, wink, half-closed eyes, playful
expressions.smitten: smitten, sparkling eyes, warm smile, blush
expressions.yearning: yearning, longing gaze, parted lips, wistful, looking away
expressions.sultry: sultry, bedroom eyes, half-closed eyes, parted lips, seductive smile
expressions.aroused: flushed face, heavy breathing, half-closed eyes, parted lips, needy expression
expressions.embarrassed: embarrassed, flustered, blush, wavy mouth, nervous smile
expressions.thinking: thinking, pensive, looking up, thoughtful, closed mouth
expressions.determined: determined, serious, furrowed brow, clenched jaw
expressions.sleepy: sleepy, drowsy, half-closed eyes, tired, small yawn

notes: If a face barely changes vs neutral, bump cfg to 6 in the character spec, or add stronger tags (e.g. 'open mouth', ';)', 'clenched teeth').

If the character drifts between expressions, the seed is doing its job least on the big changes (laughing, surprised) - regenerate just those with a different seed until they match, via: make-sprites.mjs --only laughing,surprised --seed <n>.
sultry / aroused stay face-only; the base prompt has no nsfw/explicit tag so framing stays safe.
